text:
And God made me a woman,
with long hair,
a woman's eyes, nose, and mouth.

With curves
and folds
and gentle hollows,
God hollowed me out inside,
made me a workshop
for human beings.

God delicately wove my nerves
and carefully balanced
the measure of my hormones.
God made my blood
and filled me with it
so it would flow
throughout my body;
thus were born
ideas,
dreams,
instinct.

God created it all gently,
with hammer blows of breath
and drill strokes of love,
the thousand and one things
that make me a woman every day,
for which I rise with pride
every morning
and bless my sex.

translation.title: And God Made Me a Woman
